hooks.text: 落地质量直接决定速度积累，失误会掉速并可能被脚下崩塌的世界吞没
hooks.excerpt: Mind-blowing speed is key and every landing counts! Hit the ground running (literally) and you’ll build up speed, but if you fumble it will cost you. You’ll need to think fast and keep track of your ever-changing surroundings to escape before the world crumbles beneath your feet.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 十个Shard各自包含程序生成关卡，必须整组无失败通过才能解锁下一片世界
hooks.excerpt: The game consists of ten Shards, each featuring a collection of procedurally generated levels that must be completed without fail to unlock the next.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 全流程可联机合作推进，同时记录每关个人用时形成友好竞速
hooks.excerpt: You can now play through the entire game with other Zoes! It's cooperative in that you work together to progress, but we also keep track of player times in levels, which allows for some friendly and pleasant competition.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
